en: The Section on the Past and Future
He who has fully understood the aggregate of form will fully understand the aggregate of feeling? No.
Or rather, he who will fully understand the aggregate of feeling has fully understood the aggregate of form? No.
He who has not fully understood the aggregate of form will not fully understand the aggregate of feeling?
Those who will attain the path have not fully understood the aggregate of form, but they will not fail to fully understand the aggregate of feeling.
Those who possess the highest path and those worldlings who will not attain the path have neither fully understood the aggregate of form nor will they fully understand the aggregate of feeling.
Or again, whoever will not fully understand the aggregate of feeling, has he not already fully understood the aggregate of form?
An Arahant will not fully understand the aggregate of feeling, but he has not failed to fully understand the aggregate of form.

One who possesses the highest path (the path of Arhatship) and those worldlings who will not attain the path will neither fully understand the aggregate of feeling nor have they already fully understood the aggregate of form.
And one has not fully understood the aggregate of form.
